{{incomplete|needs=Missing some HG/SS quotes}} {{CharInfobox | color={{dragon color}} | corecolor={{dragon color light}} | bordercolor={{dragon color dark}} | name=Master | jname={{tt|長老|ちょうろう}}さま | tmname=Master | image=Dragon Clan Elder Adventures.png | size=150px| caption=The Dragon Clan Elder in Pokémon Adventures | gender=Male | relatives=[[Clair]] (granddaughter), [[Lance]] (grandson) | hometown=[[Blackthorn City]] | region=[[Johto]] | game=yes | generation={{gen|II}}, {{gen|IV}} | games={{v2|Crystal}}, {{game3|HeartGold and SoulSilver|HeartGold, SoulSilver|s}}}} The '''Master''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|長老|ちょうろう}}さま''' ''Master'') is the leader of the Dragon Tamer clan, a secret society of {{tc|Dragon Tamer}}s that worships {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon. He lives in the [[Dragon's Den]], which is located north of [[Blackthorn City]] in [[Johto]]. In the English release of {{game|Crystal}}, he is the leader of the dragon-user clan. In [[Pokémon Adventures]], he is known as the '''Dragon Clan Elder'''. ==In the games== [[File:Dragon Clan Elder.png|thumb|{{ga|Lyra}} and the Master in HeartGold and SoulSilver]] When spoken to for the first time, he will give the {{player}} a quiz to evaluate their care for their {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. After the quiz, the Master will reward the player with a {{p|Dratini}}, which will know the move {{m|Extreme Speed|ExtremeSpeed}} if all questions are answered correctly. In Pokémon Crystal, this is the only way Dratini can learn this move. It is obtained at [[level]] 15 in all games. Two of the Master's descendants are [[Lance]] and [[Clair]]. Both of these {{pkmn|Trainer}}s are capable {{pkmn|battle}}rs who also specialize in {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon. Sometimes, they will come to the cave and visit their relative. ===Pokémon=== ====Gives away==== If the player "incorrectly" answers the quiz, {{p|Dratini}} will know {{m|Leer}} instead of {{m|Extreme Speed}}. =====Pokémon Crystal===== {{Pokémon |gen=2 |ndex=0147 |pokemon=Dratini |gender=both |level=15 |type1=Dragon |move1=ExtremeSpeed|move1type=Normal |move2=Wrap|move2type=Normal |move3=Thunder Wave|move3type=Electric |move4=Twister|move4type=Dragon}} =====Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver===== {{Pokémon |gen=4 |ndex=0147 |pokemon=Dratini |gender=both |ability=Shed Skin |level=15 |type1=Dragon |move1=ExtremeSpeed|move1type=Normal|move1cat=Physical |move2=Thunder Wave|move2type=Electric|move2cat=Status |move3=Twister|move3type=Dragon|move3cat=Special |move4=Dragon Rage|move4type=Dragon|move4cat=Special}} ===Quotes=== ===={{game|Crystal}}==== *Meeting for the first time :''"Hm...
